workers.description: Number of worker threads for handling incoming requests.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to send DDNS update requests to.

ip.description: IP address of the DNS server.

port.description: UDP/TCP port number of the DNS server.

domains.description: List of DNS zones to manage updates for.

name.description: FQDN of the DNS zone (must end with a dot, e.g., "example.com.").

key_name.description: Name of the TSIG key used to authenticate updates (must match a key in kea-dhcp4-server or kea-dhcp6-server).

backend.description: Backend database type for DDNS records (memfile = in-memory, ephemeral; databases = persistent).

update_counter.description: Optional: Configuration for per-domain update counters (for monitoring).

key.description: Key used to index/update the counter.

dns_servers.description: Override the global DNS servers for this domain only.

control_channel.description: Optional: Unix socket for per-domain control channel.

statistics_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) for emitting DDNS statistics. Set to 0 to disable.

json_pretty_print.description: Whether to format JSON output with indentation (helps readability).

log_output.description: Output destination for logs (stderr, syslog, or file path).

log_severity.description: Minimum log severity level (messages at this level and above are logged).

log_debuglevel.description: Debug level (0–99); higher = more verbose. Ignored unless severity is DEBUG.

log_trace_output.description: Optional: Path to trace output file. If empty, trace output goes to main log.

control_channel.description: Configuration for the main control channel socket.

socket_name.description: Unix socket path for the control API.

hooks_libraries.description: List of shared libraries (hooks) to load.

library.description: Path or name of the hook library (e.g., "libdhcp_host_cmds.so").

parameters.description: JSON string of parameters for the library (must be valid JSON).

lease_file.description: Path to the lease file (only relevant when using file-based backend).

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of pending DNS update requests queued before dropping.

ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for dynamic DNS entries.
